symptom: The offered-operation adapter repair passed narrow independent review, but source publication and real Train catalog admission remain separate blockers; older idle task chats previously returned no final audit.
objective: Use two existing idle same-project chats for distinct read-only audits on one pinned canonical checkout, then integrate only visible evidence before any release or real-data work.
boundary: Read canonical local checkout only. Each worker may write only its own dedicated curated log. No source edits, provider/network calls, public fetch, purchase, catalog admission, budget mutation, release/push or Dev/Final access. An empty task completion is BLOCKED, not PASS.
resolution_check: Supervisor verifies both visible source-hashed reports, checks each cited finding and budget/process state, and obtains a separate read-only integrated verdict. This planning result does not itself authorize publication or paid work.

steps.action: Read-only inspect the exact 324-file controlled-source snapshot, dirty diff, prior independent finding and source-release manifest. Identify the minimal safe publish whitelist and any P0 release gate; deliver a visible PASS/REPLAN with file/line evidence. Do not edit, commit, tag or push.
steps.expected_artifact: Dedicated source-hashed release-scope audit log and visible final answer
steps.verification: Supervisor recomputes source digest, inspects cited files and compares proposed whitelist with actual dirty/untracked files.
steps.pass_condition: A factual release-ready or precise REPLAN verdict, explicitly excluding data, secrets, ledgers and run artifacts.
steps.failure_action: Preserve missing or negative result; keep publication closed and use a fresh scoped reviewer if needed.

result.observed: Read-only audit completed with a precise REPLAN for publication: 17 dirty controlled paths, including the shared bottleneck gate, prevent an exact-source Gate-1-only release. Supervisor independently reproduced source hash and count.
result.reviewer: Supervisor checking existing Gate 1 release-audit task

steps.action: Read-only identify the exact next evidence to admit a real Train-only catalog after Controller chooses a source: existing catalog registry, rights, identity, trade/time coverage, split and exposure checks. Do not choose the scientific source or mutate admission. Deliver a visible ordered checklist with file/line evidence and unknowns.
steps.expected_artifact: Dedicated source-hashed data-route audit log and visible final answer
steps.verification: Supervisor checks exact registry and rights evidence, ensures synthetic catalog is not represented as real and no protected rows were opened.
steps.pass_condition: A concrete lawful Train-catalog admission checklist, clearly marking missing evidence and no current real-data pass.
steps.failure_action: Mark unknown or BLOCKED; do not invent data admission or substitute another source for the Controller.

result.reviewer: Supervisor checking existing Gate 1 data-audit task

steps.verification: Read dedicated logs, verify citations and source digest; confirm no new paid run, fetch or release.
steps.pass_condition: Release readiness and real-data readiness remain separate, with honest PASS/REPLAN/BLOCKED evidence.
steps.failure_action: Keep release and provider closed; replace failed worker only for a sharply bounded check.

steps.action: After integration, review the single pinned source and combined release/data boundary without edits; return PASS or REPLAN with evidence.
